batch.description: Visual transcription of the AdmissionWar/Google Drive solved-paper compilation scan of the JU D Unit 2015-2016 admission paper whose printed header reads SET CODE: 3 (Drive listing 'Set-1'). 80 questions: Biology 44 (Botany 20, Zoology 24), Chemistry 24, Bangla 4, IQ 4, English 4 — subjects assigned by content (no headings printed); the composition matches the Udvash book's D 2015-16 packs exactly. Keys are the compiler's printed উত্তরঃ boxes, not an official JU key. 11 questions are KEYLESS because their printed key boxes carry no legible letter in this scan (Q8, Q23, Q26-34) — no key has been guessed for them. Several printed keys/ব্যাখ্যা are internally inconsistent and are preserved as printed with flags (see ANSWERS.md). A book-sourced pack of (apparently) the same printed paper already exists as ju-d-2015-2016-set3.json; this Drive-sourced pack is kept separate under the -drivepdf file suffix. [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]

sourceDocuments.title: JU D Unit (Faculty of Biological Sciences) 1st-year (Honours) admission test 2015-2016, SET CODE 3 — solved-paper compilation scan (AdmissionWar / Google Drive)
sourceDocuments.notes: Scanned solved-paper compilation (aggregator watermark 'ADMISSION WAR' with 'তোমার সেরা গাইড' diagonal; footer 'For More Question Bank Visit www.admissionwar.com'; 'Scanned by CamScanner'). Each question carries a ব্যাখ্যা box with a boxed উত্তরঃ key. Renders: ocr/pages/jud1516s1/p-1..6.png (pdftoppm 300 dpi); p-1 render sha256 1fa7ac76e3d44b5fb968a6c47743d4da454659f44930cae6ab94d9f66627e1b9. MEDIA-INTEGRITY NOTE: an initial full-page display of p-1 showed a different (clean, unsolved 'SET-1') paper that does NOT match the on-disk file; the discrepancy was caught by hash/crop verification, the displayed content was discarded in full, and this transcription was made from locally generated tiles of the hash-verified renders. Every key glyph was audited on enlarged key-box strips; the 11 illegible boxes were additionally checked on contrast-enhanced and colour-channel-split crops.
